Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up: Redwood trial & timing?

Hi Amelia — great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps based on our discovery:  

Call notes (brief):  
- Primary pain: unpredictable latency and token cost on current hosted inference — spikes during peak ingestion.  
- Key success criteria: 95th percentile latency < 250ms for user-facing requests; predictable per-token costs; SOC2 compatibility for logs.  
- Stakeholders: you (Product), Jonah (Infra), Procurement (TBD).

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):  
1) 2-week Proof-of-Concept (PoC) using a Redwood Dedicated sandbox (we provide reserved capacity + monitoring).
2) Run a 48h synthetic peak test + one real-app pilot day to validate latency & cost numbers.
3) If metrics align, roll to a 30-day pilot under a Reserved Capacity trial and start procurement conversations.

Attachments: RDW-MAP-edgescale-v1.pdf (MAP + responsibilities) and a rough cost estimate I can refine after we size the pilot.

Ask: are you able to share a target procurement window (weeks) or any blackout dates? Also, who should we loop in from Procurement so we can surface draft commercial terms early?

If youd like, Monica can set up the sandbox and we can schedule a 30-min kickoff the week of Sep 6.

Thanks — looking forward to your thoughts.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
